processNotes.theRecurringDEFECTCLASS: C-044, C-045, C-046 and C-047 were ALL the same shape: a check that PASSED while inspecting less than it appeared to. A name-level equation blind to types; a grep blind to a binary file; an assertion satisfiable by two independent mechanisms so it pinned neither; a green suite over a product whose tools all throw. LESSON, now standing: a construction that enforces an invariant must ALSO assert that it actually ran — a floor on how much it inspected, an explicit allowlist instead of a silent skip, a premise that fails when the fixture becomes unverifiable.
processNotes.mutationRevertTrap: A mutation harness that reverts with `git checkout <file>` DISCARDS UNCOMMITTED WORK. It threw away half of C-035 mid-round. Snapshot with `cp` before the first mutation; restore from the snapshot; verify with `cmp`.
processNotes.agentStrayFileTrap: Test-writers told to typecheck by copying into conductor/tests/ and deleting have twice left or removed files at a path the orchestrator was also using. A CHANGED TEST COUNT (994 -> 995) is the tell that something arrived or vanished. After ANY agent returns, run git status before trusting a gate result.
processNotes.autoformatIsNotAnAgentEdit: AUTOFORMAT_SRC_ON_CONFIGURE runs clang-format over src/ at cmake configure time. A delivered C++ test file will DIFFER from its parked copy on formatting alone. Compare whitespace-normalized before suspecting an agent edited a test.
